from typing import Literal, List
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# The set of legal causes provided in the task, used to constrain extraction
TaskCauses = Literal[
    '行政行为-行政补偿', 
    '执行案由-刑事', 
    '行政行为-行政登记', 
    '物权保护纠纷', 
    '人格权纠纷', 
    '刑事赔偿', 
    '执行案由-先予执行', 
    '执行案由-其他案由', 
    '执行案由-民事', 
    '行政主体-行政检查（监察）', 
    '非刑事赔偿-错误执行赔偿', 
    '执行案由-对下级法院执行异议裁定的复议', 
    '行政行为-行政许可', 
    '侵犯财产罪', 
    '知识产权与竞争纠纷', 
    '行政行为-行政复议', 
    '行政主体-民政行政管理（民政）', 
    '继承纠纷', 
    '知识产权与竞争', 
    '适用特殊程序案件案由', 
    '用益物权纠纷', 
    '渎职罪'
]

class DocumentMatch(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The specific title of the document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    matched_causes: List[TaskCauses] = Field(description="List of specific task causes that apply to this document. Empty if no match.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentMatch]
